lead_with.title: Montreal for network and payments operations
lead_with.text: Nostro, reconciliation, payment investigations and clearing support run around the clock. Montreal adds a **bilingual, New York-hours** operations site to Singapore and other hubs. A Finance Montréal-commissioned Boyd study puts a 150-person financial operation at about **US$18.9M a year in Montreal vs US$35.3M in New York**, in the New York time zone.

lead_with.title: The IFC tax credit
lead_with.text: Quebec's **International Financial Centre** credit can reach **C$18,000 per eligible employee per year**, including for services provided under contract to a **foreign affiliate** (compliance, data, IT, fund and transaction support). Eligibility is checked case by case.

lead_with.title: Peers already there
lead_with.text: **Morgan Stanley, BNP Paribas, Société Générale, Crédit Agricole** and **State Street** run operations in Montreal, alongside **120,000+ finance and insurance** and **150,000+ tech** professionals.

person.name: Jacqui Maughan
person.text: Standard Chartered's people page says Jacqui **leads global network and nostro management** and is based in **Singapore**. She previously led **global treasury services and financial markets operations for ASEAN and South Asia**. She joined the bank in **2017** after operations roles at **Barclays** and **Goldman Sachs** in London, Hong Kong and Singapore, and has lived in Asia for 18 years. Her exact title (Streak lists Managing Director) and reporting line are **to be confirmed**. She replied warmly and gave a personal email.

company.text: Standard Chartered serves corporates, institutions and affluent clients across Asia, Africa and the Middle East, with Transaction Banking (cash, clearing, trade) as a core strength. Group CEO **Bill Winters**. In May 2026 the bank named **Tanuj Kapilashrami** Group Chief Operating Officer, overseeing strategy and company-wide transformation, and **Manus Costello** interim Group CFO. Management says it is investing to become **'simpler, faster and more connected'** while holding costs. In the Americas the bank lists offices in the US, Brazil, Argentina and Colombia; it has **no Canadian office** today.

financials.text: **H1 2026** (released Jul 29, 2026): operating income **US$11.6B** (+6%), record profit before tax **US$4.8B** (+9%); Wealth Solutions +38%, Global Banking +19%. Operating expenses **US$6.3B** (+1%). Guidance raised: 2026 income growth near the middle of 5-7%, expenses about **US$13.3B**, RoTE above 12%; new **US$1B buyback**. A profitable bank that still watches costs closely, which suits a cost-and-talent location pitch.

industry.title: Correspondent banking is consolidating
industry.text: Global banks keep cutting the number of correspondent relationships and moving nostro and payments work into fewer, automated hubs: a live topic for her team.

industry.title: Faster payments, 24/7 operations
industry.text: Instant and cross-border payment schemes push banks towards follow-the-sun operations; a North American time zone site closes the gap between Asia and the US.

industry.title: Financial-centre competition
industry.text: Montreal competes with Toronto, New York and US nearshore cities using **cost**, **tax credits**, **bilingual talent** and **AI research**.

talking_points: Where do her **network and nostro operations** teams sit today, and is there an **Americas-hours** gap?
